headline: Executive order adjusts certain federal pay rates.
what_it_does: This executive order changes certain rates of pay. Orders with this title usually update pay schedules for people paid by the federal government, such as federal civilian workers. No summary was provided, so the exact pay changes, the amounts, and the groups covered cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may change under the schedules this order sets, though the exact changes are not stated in the available material.
